title: Joining Forces: Brands And Vendors Making 3D Digital Transformation Easier
description:
A True End-to-End Process: How Brands & Vendors Can Achieve Co-Creation. The CLO team collaborates with global stakeholders across design, production, and market launch, we can identify the opportunities for brands and vendors when working together to overcome challenges and enhance the value of their existing digital assets. This video explores the workflow, as well as the roles and responsibilities of both brands and vendors.

Shirley Chan, 3D Design & Implementation Lead at CLO Hong Kong, presents the roles of vendors in 3D digitization, illustrating how brands and vendors can collaborate for easier adoption by highlighting best practices from clients and how the global CLO offices can support on this journey. 

As Blanca Olavarria, Marks and Spencer said, "The more the brands communicates the commitment and vision, the easier it is for the vendor to enter the journey with us and make the investment."

---

summary: ```markdown # Joining Forces: Brands and Vendors Making 3D Digital Transformation Easier ## Collaboration in the Digital Supply Chain We firmly believe that joining forces and collaborating with your partners can help create an even bigger benefit for all partners involved in the digital supply chain. Everyone works together in the whole digital transformation journey. ## The Importance of 3D in Digital Transformation 3D is important; 3D is the core of the brands' digital transformation. We believe that brands should not be the only ones in this 3D digital journey. The feed and production data of the 3D file are contained but not carried to the fitting, sampling, and production stages. ## End-to-End Development with Vendors Here is an example of how the 3D digital end-to-end development can work with the vendors. When a brand starts with a new season, the design team may need to do some trend research. They can use the Closet visual board to create the trend board or utilize the data analysis function in Closet to review the last season's designs, such as which one is the most popular and which color is the best seller to consumers. ## Co-Creation with ODM Vendors We can talk about sustainability and efficiency without clothes. Meanwhile, if you work with the ODM, these vendors can share this trend board on the same platform, which is Closet, with you. Designers can co-create this visual board together with the vendors. For example, they can directly modify this visual board later to make it more customized. The vendor will then understand more about your final design direction. ## Iterative Design Process The vendor can also base their updated direction on these modifications to create more 3D designs and present more materials in the Virtual Showroom in Closet. Once the direction is confirmed, if you like the design style proposed by your vendors, the designer can also comment and modify the outline, perhaps making small adjustments in their file or allowing the vendors to create or modify it for you. ## Material Provision and Creative Freedom You can work with your vendors who will provide you with the pattern blocks, trims, and fabrics, presenting you with the digital format of these assets as well. When all these materials are ready, designers can overcome challenges and not limit their creativity due to a lack of materials to aid them. ## Transparency with Vendors On the brand side, it's essential to maintain transparency with our vendors. It's not only about the quality needed for the 3Ds or which workflows or types of files we need from them to protect the quality of the 3D garment. More importantly, it involves communicating our vision so they understand our roadmap. ## Investment and Commitment Understanding the commitment we have is crucial because, for them, the role involves a significant amount of investment. This includes investment in the right equipment, the right software, and the right talent, which is quite difficult to find and nurture. ## Utilizing Digital Assets for Promotion We don't need to wait to have a physical sample to promote our products. Vendors can also reuse the assets they create, consolidating the files to present their capacity for more business opportunities. For example, they can create an e-lookbook to facilitate outbound sales. ## E-Commerce Integration You can also use these digital files on your e-commerce website to predict how consumers will respond to your products. The more the brand communicates its commitment and vision, the easier it is for the vendors to join us on this journey and make the necessary investments. ```
